summary: Found one repo: Lucaz97/Agentic-HLS. This is the authors' own code for the paper, confirmed by (1) GitHub username Lucaz97 matching first author Luca Collini (NYU Tandon PhD student in ECE), (2) repo name 'Agentic-HLS' matching the paper's agentic HLS optimization framework, (3) input benchmarks (aes, present, sha256, kmp, nw, filter) exactly matching Table I in the paper, (4) output logs matching the paper's DeepSeek-V3/DeepSeek-R1/o3-mini experiments, and (5) the paper's statements 'Code, benchmarks, and raw results are provided here' and 'We open-source our framework'. The repo contains Catapult HLS configurations and HLS C/C++ code, confirmed by the HLS scan which found 336 HLS files with both Catapult and Vitis dialects. No explicit GitHub URL appears in the paper — the anonymous.4open.science link was used for double-blind review — so the repo was found by search and has provenance 'own_found_by_search'.
